items.title: ‘Temple is made for the world’: Deepinder Goyal says doesn’t expect more than 1% sale in India amid debate over pricing
items.summary: Temple founder Deepinder Goyal defended the forehead-worn wellness device’s ₹85,000 price, saying it was designed for global markets. Pre-orders opened November 1, with shipping expected in early 2027. Goyal describes Temple as a fitness and AI device, not a medical product.

items.title: Anthropic plans IPO live stream with Amodei, JPMorgan CEO Dimon
items.summary: Anthropic PBC is preparing for a live-streamed event featuring CEO Dario Amodei and JPMorgan Chase CEO Jamie Dimon. This event is aimed at marketing their upcoming initial public offering, which might break records. The IPO is set to begin marketing shortly and is planned to debut before the Thanksgiving holiday. Anthropic is targeting an offering size similar to SpaceX's IPO, which raised significant funding.

items.title: Who is RamG Vallath? Meet ex-Airtel COO who left corporate life to become a speaker; what he said about work stress
items.summary: Former Airtel COO RamG Vallath once dreamed of becoming the CEO of a Fortune 500 company. But a rare autoimmune disorder left him paralysed in his 40s, forcing him to step away from corporate life. He has now spoken about workplace stress, his health battle, and rebuilding his career.

items.title: Anthropic sends out $69.3 billion IPO details, then retracts, tells banks they will update new figures
items.summary: Anthropic reportedly circulated and then retracted details of its planned IPO, including a proposed sale of 867 million shares at $70 to $80 each. The company said the pricing information was inaccurate and would be updated. Investors have discussed valuations of $1.1 trillion to $1.3 trillion.

items.title: Anthropic retracts details of $69 billion IPO filing sent to bankers. Why analysts are raising worries over valuations
items.summary: Anthropic initially shared its IPO filing details but later retracted the information due to inaccuracies. The company aimed to sell approximately 867 million shares priced between $70 and $80 each. A follow-up email clarified that these pricing details were incorrect. Anthropic indicated that an updated filing would be provided later. The company has chosen not to provide further comments regarding the situation.

items.title: RBI said to query bank valuations of some bond derivative trades
items.summary: India's central bank has informed some lenders about the need to adjust bond forward accounting practices. This change could impact billions of dollars in assets across the banking sector. The Reserve Bank of India suggested using Level 3 inputs for valuing bond-forward trades during recent audits. Banks have been in discussions with industry associations and clearinghouses for potential solutions and better pricing…

items.title: Oil falls as Trump downplays prospect of escalation with Iran
items.summary: Oil prices fell due to President Trump's announcement regarding US military action against Iran, easing supply concerns. Brent crude futures dropped to $92.33 per barrel while WTI futures reached $86.50. Trump stated he would maintain a naval blockade in the Strait of Hormuz temporarily. OPEC's oil output increased in October, supported by higher production from Saudi Arabia and Kuwait.
